newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African gold stocks end firmer on bullion.
newsitem.headline: S.African gold stocks end firmer on bullion.

text.p: South African gold shares edged slightly firmer to close on Tuesday on the back of a firmer bullion price after retracing earlier losses, dealers said.
Industrials were weaker for most of the day, briefly hopping up before slipping again in early afternoon and finishing the day just under opening levels.
Dealers said industrials were weighed by expected disappointing results from some key industrial companies and failed to even take heart from Wall Street's overnight gains.
Industrial giant South African Breweries lost ground throughout the day ahead nf its year results, due in the afternoon, which proved lacklustre.
SAB on Tuesday posted diluted earnings per share for the year ended March 31, at 605.3 cents versus 540.8 -- below the consensus of analysts polled by Reuters of 617.8 cents.
The gold index finished 7.6 points up at 1,275.4, the industrial index ended down 1.4 points at 8,474.7 and the all-share was up 2.8 points at 7,193.1.
Dealers said volumes on the day were moderate with around 800 million rand worth of shares exchanging hands in quiet trade.
Underlying sentiment remained positive but cautious as market players sought direction, they added.
Dealers expected Wednesday's trade to be little changed.
